package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestRevisionTrustedTaskWirePreservesAssessmentKeys(t *testing.T) {
	v := &domain.LessonRevision{Schema: domain.LessonRevisionSchema, LessonID: "lesson", LessonRevisionID: "revision", Content: domain.LessonRevisionContent{Tasks: []domain.LessonRevisionTask{{Task: domain.Task{ID: "quiz", Type: domain.TaskTypeTest, EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto}, Tests: []domain.TaskTest{{ID: "question", Variants: []domain.TaskTestVariant{{ID: "answer", IsCorrect: true}}}}}}}}
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	writeRevision(w, v, nil)
	var payload struct {
		Content struct {
			Tasks []struct {
				ID             string `json:"id"`
				EvaluationMode string `json:"evaluation_mode"`
				Tests          []struct {
					Variants []struct {
						IsCorrect *bool `json:"is_correct"`
					} `json:"variants"`
				} `json:"tests"`
			} `json:"tasks"`
		} `json:"content"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	task := payload.Content.Tasks[0]
	if task.ID != "quiz" || task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || task.Tests[0].Variants[0].IsCorrect == nil || !*task.Tests[0].Variants[0].IsCorrect {
		t.Fatalf("trusted scoring contract lost: %s", w.Body.String())
	}
}
